Perfect! All tests pass. The FESTIVE15 discount code (15% off) has been successfully added to the invoicing system. 

The new discount code:
- Is case-insensitive (handled by the `strip().upper()` call in the `apply_discount` function)
- Applies 15% off to any invoice subtotal
- Follows the same pattern as the existing WELCOME10 discount
- Is capped at the subtotal (won't make the total negative)
